keyVerseDR: "...he breathed on them; and he said to them: Receive ye the Holy Ghost." (Jn 20:22)

level1.title: The Holy Spirit Comes
level1.story: Jesus' friends were afraid behind locked doors. Jesus came and said, "Peace be with you!" He breathed on them and said, "Receive the Holy Spirit!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus give His friends?
How does the Spirit help you?
level1.prayer: Come, Holy Spirit, fill my heart. Amen.

activity.title: Gifts of the Holy Spirit
activity.intro: Color each flame as you pray, "Come, Holy Spirit!"

level2.title: Receive the Holy Spirit
level2.story: On the evening of Easter, the disciples were behind locked doors because they were afraid. Jesus came and stood among them and said, "Peace be with you." He showed them His hands and side, and they rejoiced. Jesus said, "As the Father has sent Me, so I send you." He breathed on them and said, "Receive the Holy Spirit. Whose sins you forgive are forgiven them."
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus give the Spirit and the power to forgive?
Which gift of the Spirit do you need most?
actions: Learn the 7 gifts of the Spirit
level2.prayer: Come, Holy Spirit, set my heart on fire. Amen.

activity.title: Gifts of the Spirit
activity.intro: Find the gifts of the Holy Spirit.

art.mainBrief: Upper room: risen Jesus breathing on apostles, dove and soft flames
